companies.name: シュナイダーエレクトリック

relations.text: Schneider ElectricがPTCを買収する正式契約を結んだと発表している
relations.text_en: Announced a definitive agreement under which Schneider Electric will acquire PTC

source.label: PTC October5,2026 acquisition agreement, Q3 2027 closing anticipated, conditional; checked October17,2026
source.label_en: PTC October5,2026 acquisition agreement, Q3 2027 closing anticipated, conditional; checked October17,2026
source.quote: PTC), a leader in complex industrial product design, engineering and data management, today announced that they have signed a definitive agreement under which Schneider Electric will acquire PTC (“the transaction”).
source.note: 条件付きの買収計画です。完了は2027年第3四半期を見込みます。
source.note_en: Conditional planned acquisition; closing is anticipated in Q3 2027.

relations.text: NVIDIA Omniverseのライブラリを統合している
relations.text_en: PTC is integrating NVIDIA Omniverse libraries

source.label: PTC — NVIDIA Omniverse technology collaboration, checked October 16, 2026
source.label_en: PTC — NVIDIA Omniverse technology collaboration, checked October 16, 2026
source.quote: PTC is integrating NVIDIA Omniverse libraries, transforming how manufacturers design, simulate, and collaborate on complex products in the future.

relations.text: NVIDIAとの協力を深め、Alliance for OpenUSDに参加した
relations.text_en: PTC is deepening its collaboration with NVIDIA and joining the Alliance for OpenUSD

source.label: PTC — NVIDIA Omniverse technology collaboration, checked October 16, 2026
source.label_en: PTC — NVIDIA Omniverse technology collaboration, checked October 16, 2026
source.quote: By deepening our collaboration with NVIDIA and joining the Alliance for OpenUSD, we’re giving our customers the ability to incorporate design and configuration data in a real-time, immersive simulation environment.

relations.text: 戦略パートナーの紹介ページで、Microsoftとともにデジタルトランスフォーメーションとスマート製造を進めると説明している
relations.text_en: PTC's strategic partner page says PTC and Microsoft are accelerating digital transformation and smart manufacturing

source.label: PTC — named strategic partner directory, checked October 16, 2026
source.label_en: PTC — named strategic partner directory, checked October 16, 2026
source.quote: PTC and Microsoft are accelerating digital transformation and bringing smart manufacturing to life, thus allowing you to connect your business and enterprise processes into industrial applications.
source.note: パートナー紹介ページの記載です。

relations.text: JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A.が管理代理人を務める第4次改訂クレジット契約の第2次修正を締結した
relations.text_en: PTC entered into Amendment No. 2 to its Fourth Amended and Restated Credit Agreement with JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. as Administrative Agent

source.label: PTC 10-K
source.quote: (“PTC”) and PTC (IFSC) Limited, a subsidiary of PTC, entered into Amendment No. 2 (the “Amendment”) to the Fourth Amended and Restated Credit Agreement dated January 3, 2023 (the “Credit Agreement”) with JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., as Administrative Agent, and the Lenders named therein.
source.note: 資金調達のみの関係です。

relations.text: 同クレジット契約は2023年1月3日付である
relations.text_en: The credit agreement is dated January 3, 2023

source.label: PTC 10-K
source.quote: Fourth Amended and Restated Credit Agreement dated January 3, 2023 by and among PTC, PTC (IFSC) Limited, JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., as administrative agent, and the Lenders named therein

relations.text: PTCの年次報告が、競合として挙げている
relations.text_en: Named as a competitor in PTC’s annual report

source.label: PTC 10-K
source.quote: For enterprise CAD and PLM solutions, we compete with large established companies including Autodesk, Dassault Systèmes SA, and Siemens AG.

companies.name: ダッソー・システムズ

relations.text: 企業向けCADとPLMの競合として、Dassault Systèmesを挙げている
relations.text_en: Names Dassault Systèmes among competitors in enterprise CAD and PLM

source.label: PTC 10-K
source.quote: For enterprise CAD and PLM solutions, we compete with large established companies including Autodesk, Dassault Systèmes SA, and Siemens AG.

relations.text: ALM製品の競合として、Siemens AGを挙げている
relations.text_en: Names Siemens AG among competitors for its ALM products

source.label: PTC 10-K
source.quote: For our ALM products, we compete with IBM, Jama Software, Inc. and Siemens AG.

relations.text: ALM製品の競合として、IBMを挙げている
relations.text_en: Names IBM among competitors for its ALM products

source.label: PTC 10-K
source.quote: For our ALM products, we compete with IBM, Jama Software, Inc. and Siemens AG.

relations.text: SLM製品の競合として、Salesforceなどを挙げている
relations.text_en: Names Salesforce among competitors for its SLM products

source.label: PTC 10-K
source.quote: For our SLM products, we compete with enterprise software companies such as Oracle, SAP, IFS AB, Microsoft, and Salesforce, and with companies that offer point solutions.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
